context: The Professional Data Engineer certification course, organized by exam domain. Frame EVERY service as "which concept from earlier courses does this implement". Storage/database selection as a workload-driven decision matrix (Cloud SQL vs AlloyDB vs Spanner; Firestore vs Bigtable vs Memorystore; GCS classes/lifecycle; Datastream/DMS/BigQuery Data Transfer/Transfer Appliance); BigQuery internals (storage-compute separation, partitioning/clustering, Editions + reservations + slot autoscaling, on-demand vs capacity pricing); the BigQuery analysis+AI layer (materialized views, BI Engine, query troubleshooting, BigQuery ML at awareness level, ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING and native VECTOR_SEARCH, preparing unstructured data for embeddings/RAG); ingestion/streaming services (Pub/Sub semantics, Dataflow in production, Datastream CDC, Kafka-vs-Pub/Sub awareness); transformation/orchestration (Dataform dependency graphs, Data Fusion awareness, Composer vs Workflows selection criterion); lakehouse/governance (BigLake, Dataplex + catalog, Analytics Hub sharing); security/compliance (IAM roles/service accounts/org policies, CMEK/KMS, Cloud DLP PII masking, residency, project/dataset architecture); operate/optimize (monitoring/logging, quotas/billing troubleshooting, Dataproc persistent-vs-ephemeral with Hadoop/Spark at awareness, replication/failover/backup-DR, drawing the certification-ready reference architecture). Teach stable service SEMANTICS and decision frameworks as of early 2026; prefer principles over console UI details.
